dialogues.dialogue: Looking at it closer, it's pretty clear that there are three glowing shapes above the place to enter the digits.
The first shape connects to the first two slots, and the second shape connects to the third and fourth slots. But the final shape connects to the last three.
In each of the shapes, there is... a particular rounded line. I wonder if that means anything.
I'm sure something here relates to some sort of number that I would have to input as the code. Just what could it be though?
